[[Skale Broodcaller]] are a larger and more dangerous variant of [[River Skale]], and are always found amongst other River Skale. Skale Broodcaller have the same appearance as River Skale, but are slightly larger in size. 

Unlike River Skale, Skale Broodcaller will attack unprovoked, and cause all River Skale and [[River Skale Tad]] (in the area of each party member) to attack your allies as well.
